item.title: How much you need to be middle class in Pennsylvania, NJ and Delaware

item.title: Judge orders slavery exhibit must be restored at President's House in Philadelphia
item.description: A federal judge has ordered the Department of the Interior to immediately restore slavery exhibits at the President’s House site in Philadelphia's Independence National Historical Park.
